sloka: मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम् ।कर्माद्यो मां हरत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते ।। ५.३८.३९।।।।
transliteration: matkṛte kākamātre tu brahmāstraṁ samudīritam ।karmādyo māṁ harattvattaḥ kṣamase taṁ mahīpate ।। 5.38.39।।।।

translations.english: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?
